Execute.SQL: UPDATE e SET Status = N'PROCESSED' OUTPUT inserted.EventId, inserted.SourceSystem, inserted.EventType, ISNULL(inserted.ChildEventTypes, '') AS ChildEventTypes, inserted.OffenderId, p.Mrn, p.LastName, p.FirstName, ISNULL(p.MiddleName, '') AS MiddleName, CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), p.BirthDate, 112) AS BirthDate, p.Sex, p.Street, p.City, p.State, p.Zip, ISNULL(p.Phone, '') AS Phone, inserted.FacilityCode, ISNULL(inserted.UnitCode, '') AS UnitCode, ISNULL(inserted.BedCode, '') AS BedCode, ISNULL(inserted.PriorFacilityCode, '') AS PriorFacilityCode, ISNULL(inserted.PriorUnitCode, '') AS PriorUnitCode, ISNULL(inserted.PriorBedCode, '') AS PriorBedCode, ISNULL(inserted.AttendingNpi, '') AS AttendingNpi, ISNULL(inserted.AttendingName, '') AS AttendingName, CONVERT(VARCHAR(19), inserted.EventTimestamp, 126) AS EventTimestamp, inserted.Status, ISNULL(inserted.Notes, '') AS Notes FROM dbo.OperationalEvents e INNER JOIN dbo.Patients p ON p.OffenderId = e.OffenderId WHERE e.Status = N'PENDING'
